Typed model identity bridge and fresh-process attack audit

summary: All 3 completed experiments were compute-bound and occupied 1.8 minutes. Official-live model report evidence requalification was longest at 1.68 minutes, but the supplied data does not identify why; the locked GPU-idle indicator is false, and no data available establishes a simultaneous multi-model workload or a DualGPURunner miss.
bottlenecks_identified: Official-live model report evidence requalification set the critical path at 1.68 of 1.8 minutes, while the timing data provides no internal phase breakdown that explains the duration.

The end-state GPU snapshot is not correlated to individual task windows, and no model-concurrency or runner-selection record is supplied; compute-task utilization efficiency and DualGPURunner applicability therefore cannot be determined.
improvements_suggested: Add nested phase timing to model-report evidence requalification so the source of its 1.68-minute duration is visible.
Add an input-fingerprint cache that bypasses requalification work when the official-live report evidence is unchanged.
Capture per-experiment GPU utilization across each compute task's execution window instead of relying on a single end-state snapshot.
Stamp model concurrency and runner selection into each experiment artifact, and route only workloads declaring 2 or more models in parallel through carnot.pipeline.dual_gpu_harness.DualGPURunner.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Cache unchanged official-live report evidence to target the milestone's longest experiment.
Instrument phase timing and task-window GPU utilization for every compute-bound experiment.
Record model concurrency and runner selection, with DualGPURunner dispatch limited to declared parallel workloads of 2 or more models.
meta_reflection: The data isolates one dominant duration but does not include causal phase timing or task-window accelerator and concurrency evidence. Those signals should be captured at execution time; no measured basis for nonzero time savings is available this milestone.
